name: prompt-input
title: Prompt input
description: Where a message is written and sent: a raised plate with the host's attached files, a well that grows from one line, attach (picked, dropped or pasted), the host's tools such as a model select, and Send that becomes Stop while a reply writes. ↩ sends and ⇧↩ breaks the line; disabled with a reason when offline.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/prompt-input.md. SwiftUI: MetalPromptInput in the MetalUI Swift package.
